name: Water Traversal, Depth & Current Gameplay Runtime
design_rules: ankle-deep water preserves normal exploration with a small speed penalty
waist-deep water becomes deliberate wading and consumes stamina
swimming starts only when depth exceeds the configured wading threshold
current pushes the character downstream independently of input
strong current increases stamina cost while swimming or wading
exhaustion does not instantly kill the character but removes effective upstream progress
temporary streams from AF-001AR remain normally traversable
water traversal never uses emissive or glow feedback
